data.name: PokerFace
data.detailed_description:
A Unique Experience in Gambling!

An online poker experience fueled by your live expressions! Watch your opponents' screens closely-- what you see from their face might be the difference between your win or loss! Tells are one of the most important factors in a poker game, and through the use of webcams, this can be brought into the digital world!

Initial Playtest Features

  • Classic poker game loop

  • Singleplayer mode

  • Main menu screen

Planned Features

  • Live multiplayer, hosted P2P, eliminating the need for dedicated servers

  • Expression detection using a webcam that is then communicated throughout the clients and server

  • Your classic poker game loop

Potential Additions

  • Alternative expression through quick-time events (harder to hit when your cards are worse)

  • Voice and text chat

  • Python-powered AI poker face trainer

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / GTX 960 or AMD R9 270
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1650 Super / GTX 1660 / RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
